records.title: Deformable DETR: Deformable Transformers for End-to-End Object Detection
records.reason: Full text §§4–5.1 and Table 1 describe image detection and report FPS for DETR variants; the speed/accuracy results are for COCO visual detection, with no LLM inference evaluation.

records.title: WavLM: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Pre-Training for Full Stack Speech Processing
records.reason: WavLM is speech-processing pretraining/representation work; its abstract reports downstream speech benchmark performance and no language-model inference resource optimization.

records.title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model
records.reason: The stated task is visual perception with a 2D scan architecture and image scaling efficiency; no language-model serving or inference-memory result is proposed.

records.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
records.reason: The full text (§§2–3 and experiments) evaluates query-document passage ranking, offline document representations, and retrieval FLOPs/latency. Its gains concern search/ranking, not autoregressive generation or model-serving cost; retain as borderline for possible RAG retrieval-pipeline relevance.

records.title: Edge Intelligence: Paving the Last Mile of Artificial Intelligence With Edge Computing
records.reason: The abstract surveys edge intelligence across general AI applications; it does not present or evaluate a specific LLM inference improvement.
